_comment: Top-level site config. `assets_root` is the URL prefix the website fetches scene grids, source thumbnails, and comparison images from. For local development point at `./web_assets`; for deployment point at your Hugging Face dataset's `resolve/main` URL. `eager_preload_full` controls whether to immediately fetch every cell of the active (scene, preset) on selection so motion is instant: leaves the demo snappy at the cost of ~80 MB up-front per scene-preset combination. Set to false if reviewers are likely on metered connections.
